title: hud.element 1.1
description: ui::HudElement: an addon's elements in one of the game's HUD dials, a stock scene or a stock screen. The build composes every enabled addon's records for a dial into one grown dial scene, its dial template groups and the editor preview. Sprites are PNG files, positions are HUD units (1 unit = 1 px of a 640x360 frame, origin at the dial centre, v down).

dial.description: The car class dial the elements live in: f1_26 (the 2026 dial), f1_25 (the 2025 dial) or f2. The spectator HUD's dial of the same class runs the same elements.

scene.description: Advanced target, in place of dial: the eaid:// path of a stock scene (.idf) the elements grow. Takes text and group elements only. Needs parent_ui and no dial.

parent_ui.description: With scene: the dotted path in the HUD template of the node that instances the scene (the root name first), such as hud_mfd_dynamic.mfd.attacher.car_damage_panel. The bound nodes go straight under it, named <prefix>_<name>.

units.description: The HUD unit of every at, bounds, box, pitch and cap_height in the record. hud: 1 unit = 1 px of a 640x360 frame (0.018 scene units). tower: 1 unit = 1/3 px at 1080p (0.03 scene units), Project Halo's tower unit. Absent: hud.

screen.description: A stock screen the elements live on, in place of dial or scene: standings (the track-position board), replay or spectator, or the raw form naming the template, parent_ui, host scene, instance, masks and archives.

show.description: With screen: the binding that shows the host and hides the screen's stock masks (visible of the host, NOT visible of each mask). Default false, so the stock parts stay while the leaf is absent.

also.description: With screen: the same elements on more screens, by screen name, each with its own show.

hide.description: Element ids hidden for good on this screen (a static visible = false inside the instance).

stock_nodes.description: Changes to the game's own parts: per template node, the scene elements to hide, statically or while a binding is true.

scene.description: The stock scene the elements belong to, when the template node itself names none.

wrap.description: Elements a stock node already targets (a second visible on them would not hold): each gets a new null <prefix>_w_<element> around it in the scene, in its place and with its name, and the wrapper is hidden instead. Needs scene.

clock.description: With a text that reads session time_remaining_str: output is the record's own leaf the cloned stock formatter writes (view_model_data.<name>), start a bool leaf whose change re-formats it (an MVCD, state 1) besides the record's own trigger.

restyle.description: Scene-level edits that add, move or rename no element: per stock scene, fill quads refilled from a sprite through their mesh slot, elements hidden (isHidden plus a static hide node under every template parent), elements scaled about a pivot, texts restyled and element params set. Or a preset: { preset: banner, sprite } is Project Halo's Race Control banner restyle with the fills from that sprite.

spectator.description: False leaves the spectator HUD's dial of this class without the elements.

stock.description: What happens to the stock dial's parts: keep leaves them, hide has the dial template hide them, park moves them off screen. Absent: park in f1_26, hide in the other dials.

stock_parts.description: The stock parts keep, hide and park act on. Absent: frame, fuel, holder_central and pit_indicator.

box.description: The customisation footprint in HUD units, [x0, y0, x1, y1]. Absent: the bounds of the sprite named base, or of every sprite.

root_y.description: Where the record's root lands, in the record's units, v down from the dial centre (a root at 16 sits 16 units below the centre; the elements' at are relative to it). Absent: the bottom of box lands on the stock bottom customisation point of each dial.

prefix.description: The start of every element and template node name the record adds. Absent: the addon id and the record key, lowercase, with _ between words.

sprites.description: The art, by name: a PNG of the addon, or a stock texture of the game.

variants.description: Other dials the same art serves, as patches on this record, by name.

extends.description: Data files only: this record is a variant of that record, and its value is a merge patch on the base.

png.description: A PNG in the addon, straight alpha. The core bleeds the edge colour into the transparent pixels and encodes sRGB BC7. Its width and height are multiples of 4.

bounds.description: Where the sprite sits, [x0, y0, x1, y1] in HUD units. Absent: centred on the origin at ppu pixels per unit.

tint.description: A colour that multiplies the pixels (the editor preview uses it for team-coloured white art). On a texture sprite it tints through the material.

texture.description: In place of png: the eaid:// path of a stock .tif the sprite draws. No surface is written; the material links the game's own texture.

fit.description: With texture: the box [w, h] in HUD units the texture is centred and scaled into, keeping its aspect.

bind.description: A value the template binds. Exactly one of view_model, path, game, session and session_car. view_model is one of the addon's leaves (view_model_data.<name>, or ui_menu_data.<name> where a record targets a scene); path is any other path of the game's view model, with ty the tag the game gives it; game is a name in the core's table of the dial's own values; session is a #session path; session_car reads a car of the session by vehicle id.

path.description: A dotted path of the game's own view model (#session.number_of_laps, #view_model_data.hud.content.lap_times.pill_0.active). A visible reads it as a bool, a tint as a colour, a texture as text; a text needs ty. When a stock node binds the path the tag is checked against it; a wrong tag crashes the game.

slot_var.description: With session_car, in place of slot: the var of an enclosing repeat whose index is the car slot.

screen.description: A value of the screen itself, from the core's table: series_logo is the screen's own logo texture leaf.

ty.description: The value's type. On a leaf: bool, text, i32 (written as a signed int, bound si32) or f32. On a path: the tag the game gives the value, si32, ui32, text or bool.

default.description: The value while the leaf is absent: a bool for visible, a #RRGGBBAA colour for tint, a string for texture.

repeat.description: On a group: the composer makes count copies of the group. {VV} in every string of the subtree (names, view_model, session, literal, show, slot_var) is the two-digit zero-padded index, {V} the plain index, where V is var. Copy i sits at at + pitch * (i - from). Nested repeats substitute both vars; depth at most 2 and at most 1024 copies per record.

motion.description: On a group: a timed slide (position keys, HUD units, local space) or fade (two alpha keys) a stock curve times, started by the bool leaf play_on (event 1) and reversed when it falls (event 0).

hidden.description: Never shown: isHidden in the scene and a static visible = false template node (isHidden alone does not hide in game).

colour.description: On a text or sprite: one fixed colour, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA, as a static colourOverride node.

literal_id.description: A text whose value is a game string id (lng_lap, lng_sector): the node writes localise true and the id as the text.

dir.description: On a stack: the way its children are laid out, from the first child. Absent: down.

gap.description: On a stack: the space between children, in HUD units. Absent: 0.

unit.description: On a unit: the stock unit scene the element instances, from the core's table: team_logo, series_logo or tyre_icon.

size.description: On a unit: the width of its quad in HUD units.

texture.description: On a unit: the binding of its quad's texture (a textureOverride node with the stock tag).

before.description: A variant's add entries only: the id of an element of the base this one is drawn in front of (it goes just before it in the same list). Absent, with no after or replace: the entry goes last at the top level.

after.description: A variant's add entries only: the id of an element of the base this one goes just behind, in the same list.

replace.description: A variant's add entries only: the id of an element of the base this one takes the place of. The replaced id is free inside the variant, so the entry may reuse it.

decision.description: A decision node of the template. svcd compares one value with equals and shows the elements in yes (the others in no); mvcd shows, for each state of a value, the elements listed for that state. The value is game (a dial's own, from the core's table) or on (a path or view_model binding; a screen record decides on paths only, and only on a screen whose parent registers decisions, the standings).

initial.description: The state (an mvcd) or yes / no (an svcd) whose elements start shown: their template nodes default to visible, so they are on screen until the value first fires. Absent: every listed element starts hidden.

preview.description: What the HUD editor shows: leaf, game value and session path names as keys, and the value each reads in the preview.

rows.description: How many copies of a repeated group the editor preview shows (the tower shows 5). Absent: every copy the preview lights.

add.description: Elements this dial adds; an entry with before, after or replace keeps its place in the draw order, the others go last at the top level.

decisions.description: Decisions built for this variant's dial only, after the record's; they may show the variant's own add elements.

root_y.description: This variant's root y, over the record's.
